entries.readback: Full changed-file source and complete diff read; unchanged contracts retain the prior per-claim static assessment. This is not compiler type output.
entries.before_statement:
theorem size_isBigO_comparisons (lt cmp : α → α → Bool) (inputs : Nat → List α)
    (hlen : ∀ n, (inputs n).length = n) :
    Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop (fun n => (n : ℝ))
      (fun n => (comparisons lt cmp (inputs n) : ℝ))
entries.after_statement:
theorem size_isBigO_comparisons (lt cmp : α → α → Bool) (inputs : Nat → List α)
    (hlen : ∀ n, (inputs n).length = n) :
    Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop (fun n : Nat => (n : ℝ))
      (fun n => (comparisons lt cmp (inputs n) : ℝ))
entries.prior_author_assessment: Growth transport of eventual n<=2*C from the unconditional source scan lower bound.
